title: Motif Jengkol
genre: Indonesian late-60s beat pop (Koes Plus style)
subject: a cap stamper at a batik workshop in Pekalongan who presses the hot copper stamp four hundred times a day, ordered by the owner's wife to stamp her new design, a jengkol-bean motif, onto three hundred metres of cloth, which the town hall then picks as the Friday uniform, so the whole town wears his stinky-bean batik and he walks around deadpan proud
caption: Indonesian late-60s beat pop in the Koes Plus and Dheng Dheng Plas tradition, Beat-era rock 'n' roll sung in Indonesian. A jangly clean electric rhythm guitar strumming eighth notes; a twangy lead guitar answering each line with short fills; a buzzy Farfisa-style combo organ holding the chords; a melodic picked electric bass; bright live drums with a tambourine on every beat. Dry live-room 1960s recording, guitars panned wide, slight tape saturation. Male baritone lead, relaxed conversational singing with dry deadpan wit, light group shouts in the chorus. 148 BPM, D major. Goofy, bright and deadpan proud. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no synths, no EDM, no dangdut or koplo kendang, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - jangly guitar riff and combo organ, drums kick in]

[Verse 1]
Jam tujuh pagi malam sudah mendidih
Cap tembaga kucelup, kutekan, kuangkat lagi
Empat ratus kali sehari, nggak pernah meleset
Sambungan motifku rapi kayak ubin masjid

[Pre-Chorus]
Lalu Bu Bos datang bawa gambar di kertas
"Ini motif baru," katanya, "motif jengkol"

[Chorus]
Jengkol, jengkol, tiga ratus meter
Kanan kiri, atas bawah, jengkol semua
Tanganku cap, cap, cap sampai sore
Kain wangi malam, motifnya bau dikit

[Verse 2]
Pak Lurah mampir, katanya cuma lihat-lihat
Pulangnya pesan seragam buat hari Jumat
Sekarang satu kantor pakai bajuku
Tukang parkir, guru, sampai Pak Camat

[Chorus]
Jengkol, jengkol, tiga ratus meter
Kanan kiri, atas bawah, jengkol semua
Setiap Jumat aku jalan pelan-pelan
Lihat kerjaku lewat naik motor

[Bridge - drums and tambourine only, handclaps]
Ada yang bilang ini motif paling aneh se-Pekalongan
Aku diam saja, aku cuma tukang cap

[Chorus]
Jengkol, jengkol, tiga ratus meter
Bu Bos sudah gambar motif pete
Aku celup cap lagi, nggak usah tanya
Jumat depan sekota pakai pete

[Outro - twangy guitar fill, organ chord, drums stop]
